stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The bell song reminded students that familiar things may still be special.”?
options: Sometimes it takes visitors to make people notice what they already have.
Sometimes it works best when people barely notice it.
Sometimes people improve faster when they are not afraid of being judged.
Sometimes an object becomes important because of the feelings people leave there.
